transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: I was thinking about that March 2025 trip again—Shanghai really felt nonstop the whole time.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: Getting there was a blur too; I remember it was Beijing to Shanghai on the train, and the station was packed.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: And then right after that leg, we detoured to Xi'an for a couple days—so many food stalls everywhere.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: For Shanghai, my coworker Chen Ming had already booked us into Pudong Shangri-La, so I didn’t have to deal with any of it.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: We checked in on 2025-03-15 and stayed 3 nights—honestly the timing worked out perfectly for once.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: The Beijing–Shanghai ticket was under Liu Yang, train G3, First Class—pretty sure it was on 2025-03-20.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: In Xi'an they also pre-booked Giant Wild Goose Pagoda for 2025-03-19 at 10:00 for five of us under Liu Yang, and I remember we even canceled a ride afterward—ride ID RIDE789012—since we ended up walking back.

intent.ambiguity_notes: Weak/negative case: the user is reminiscing about a completed 2025 trip; bookings and the ride cancellation already happened, described in past tense with no request for help.
